lead: A browser extension idea for the moments when an unfamiliar word interrupts your reading. Select a word or a passage, explore its meaning nearby, and keep your place.
access: An early prototype is being explored. Pontix is not available as a finished public extension.
readBody: The article, webpage or passage you chose is the starting point. The idea is to bring language support into your reading.
understandBody: The early sidebar prototype explores selected-text translation, with multiple translation services and saved preferences.
connectBody: The direction is to connect words you encounter with dictionary lookup and vocabulary practice in 2000nl. This connection is still in development.
